execute: {echo: false, warning: false}
unaltraweb_compute:
  engine: python
  mode: figure
  inputs: [context/inputs/visibilitat-costa.json]
  outputs: [assets/img/generated/visibilitat-perfils.svg]
---

```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import json,numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
root=Path.cwd()
while not (root/'.unaltraweb/computations.yml').exists():root=root.parent
d=json.loads((root/'context/inputs/visibilitat-costa.json').read_text())
profiles=[next(p for p in d['profiles'] if p['receiver']==rid) for rid in ['R1','R3']]
for p in profiles:
    for surface in ['mdt','mds']:
        assert int(p[surface+'_minimum_clearance_m']>0)==p[surface+'_visible']
plt.rcParams.update({'font.family':'DejaVu Sans','font.size':13,'svg.fonttype':'none'})
fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,2,figsize=(9.5,8.0),gridspec_kw={'height_ratios':[2,1]})
fig.subplots_adjust(left=.10,right=.98,bottom=.20,top=.91,wspace=.20,hspace=.65)
lower=10*np.floor(min(min(p['mdt_z']) for p in profiles)/10)-5
upper=10*np.ceil(max(max(p['mds_z']) for p in profiles)/10)+10
near=[]
for p in profiles:
    keep=np.array(p['distance_m'])>=p['distance_m'][-1]-80
    near.extend(np.array(p['mdt_z'])[keep]);near.extend(np.array(p['mds_z'])[keep]);near.extend(np.array(p['line_z'])[keep])
detail_limits=(5*np.floor(min(near)/5)-2,5*np.ceil(max(near)/5)+2)
for col,(p,title) in enumerate(zip(profiles,['A · T–R1: visió amb els dos models','B · T–R3: l’MDS intercepta'])):
    ax=axes[0,col]
    distance=np.array(p['distance_m'])/1000
    ax.fill_between(distance,p['mdt_z'],lower,color='#ebe2cd')
    ax.plot(distance,p['mdt_z'],color='#8e743c',lw=1.7,label='MDT')
    ax.plot(distance,p['mds_z'],color='#267869',lw=1.3,label='MDS màxim a 5 m')
    ax.plot(distance,p['line_z'],color='#a33555',lw=2,ls='--',label='Línia de visió')
    ax.plot([0,distance[-1]],[p['line_z'][0],p['line_z'][-1]],'o',color='#a33555',ms=5)
    ax.annotate('T',xy=(0,p['line_z'][0]),xytext=(6,8),textcoords='offset points',weight='bold')
    ax.annotate(p['receiver'],xy=(distance[-1],p['line_z'][-1]),xytext=(-28,8),textcoords='offset points',weight='bold')
    ax.set(xlabel='Distància des de T (km)',ylim=(lower,upper),xlim=(0,distance[-1]))
    ax.set_title(title,fontsize=14,weight='bold',pad=22);ax.grid(alpha=.2);ax.tick_params(labelsize=12)
    close=axes[1,col];distance_m=np.array(p['distance_m']);keep=distance_m>=distance_m[-1]-80
    remaining=distance_m[-1]-distance_m[keep]
    close.plot(remaining,np.array(p['mdt_z'])[keep],color='#8e743c',lw=1.7)
    close.plot(remaining,np.array(p['mds_z'])[keep],color='#267869',lw=1.7)
    close.plot(remaining,np.array(p['line_z'])[keep],color='#a33555',lw=2,ls='--')
    close.set(xlim=(80,0),ylim=detail_limits,xlabel=f'Metres fins a {p["receiver"]}')
    close.set_title('Detall dels últims 80 m',fontsize=13,pad=10);close.set_xticks([80,40,0]);close.grid(alpha=.2)
    close.tick_params(labelsize=12)
axes[0,0].set_ylabel('Cota corregida (m)');axes[1,0].set_ylabel('Cota (m)')
handles,labels=axes[0,0].get_legend_handles_labels()
fig.legend(handles,labels,loc='lower center',ncol=3,frameon=False,bbox_to_anchor=(.5,.07),fontsize=13)
fig.text(.5,.025,'Mateixos extrems absoluts · Curvatura 0,85714 · Escala vertical exagerada',ha='center',fontsize=13)
fig.savefig(root/'assets/img/generated/visibilitat-perfils.svg',facecolor='white',metadata={'Date':None});plt.close(fig)
```
